payload.text: High-fidelity, modern, minimalist landing page UI for "SimpleAgentix," an AI workflow automation SaaS. Dominant background is white/light gray. Primary colors are Deep Teal/Navy Blue for text, and secondary colors are Vibrant Green and Warm Orange for highlights and CTAs. Prominently feature the SimpleAgentix logo in the header. The Hero section must display the H1: 'AI Automation, Made Simple' and a clean, illustrative graphic of a simple, connecting workflow. Include two prominent CTAs: 'Start Free' (in the vibrant color) and 'See Live Demo'. Below the hero, include a clean, 3-column feature section. UI/UX design, Web design, Figma style, Clean interface, 4K render.

**Designing a SimpleAgentix Landing Page**

I'm currently focused on designing the SimpleAgentix landing page. The goal is a high-fidelity, modern, minimalist aesthetic. This involves sketching out potential layouts and choosing appropriate color palettes and typography. My focus is on creating a visually appealing and user-friendly interface.


**Incorporating Feature Details**

I'm now incorporating detailed feature specifications into the design.  The SimpleAgentix logo will be prominent in the header. For the Hero section, I'm using "AI Automation, Made Simple" as the H1, complemented by a workflow graphic and prominent CTAs: "Start Free" and "See Live Demo." I've specified a 3-column layout below for the features section. I'm focusing on the chatbot powered by `gemini-3-pro-preview`, fast AI responses from `gemini-2.5-flash-lite-latest`, audio transcription with `gemini-2.5-flash`, and Text-to-Speech using `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts`.


**Detailing Technical Implementation**

I'm presently outlining the technical architecture, aiming for simplicity and efficiency. My focus is now on the file structure: `index.tsx` for the React root, `App.tsx` handling components, `types.ts` for data definitions, and `services/geminiService.ts` to manage API calls using `@google/genai`. I've chosen React 18+ with createRoot, Tailwind CSS via CDN for styling, and Lucide React for consistent icons. The plan includes `metadata.json` for name, description, and permissions, plus standard HTML boilerplate.


**Developing Interactive Demo Components**

I'm currently focused on the "Interactive Demo" section. I need a place on the page, or a modal, or a dedicated section below the features to showcase the functional parts: chat (standard and thinking), fast response (lite), and audio tools (transcription and TTS). I am thinking tabs or accordion-style sections for each of these features. Also considering ways to integrate the Gemini APIs, like `gemini-2.5-flash` for audio, `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts` for TTS, and `gemini-3-pro-preview` for complex thinking. I will need to handle audio blobs and base64 conversion.


**Finalizing Gemini Integration**

I'm now integrating the Gemini API calls. Audio transcription involves recording audio in-browser, converting it to base64, and sending it to `gemini-2.5-flash` with the prompt "Transcribe this audio." For TTS, I'll take text input, feed it to `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts`, get an audio buffer, and play it.  There'll be a toggle for "Deep Think" using `gemini-3-pro-preview`.  Visually, I'm considering Deep Teal (Slate 900 or custom) for the background, vibrant Green for accents, and warm Orange for certain elements, and have added microphone permission in metadata.


**Confirming Model Specificity**

I'm now clarifying the use of `gemini-flash-lite-latest` for low-latency AI responses. The original plan to use `gemini-2.5-flash-lite` seems potentially incorrect, so I'm sticking with the guidelines which mention this model id. I will double-check to confirm if `gemini-2.5-flash-lite` is a valid alias before proceeding further with that specific model id.


**Clarifying Model IDs and Components**

I'm now revising model specificity to address the latest corrections. `gemini-2.5-flash-lite-001` is confirmed for fast responses, and I'll use `gemini-flash-lite-latest` as the "common name". Thinking mode utilizes `gemini-3-pro-preview` with a `thinkingBudget` of 32768, while `maxOutputTokens` will remain unset.  I've defined key components: `AudioRecorder` for transcription, `ChatInterface` for the chat, and `TextToSpeech` for generating audio. I'm focusing on organizing the "Interactive Demo" into tabbed cards, with separate tabs for Smart Chat (standard with thinking toggle), Fast & Lite (flash lite), and Voice Hub (TTS and transcription).


**Defining Icon Usage**

I'm now focusing on the Hero section icons, opting for `lucide-react` to ensure a consistent, clean, and performant design. I'll use a placeholder or SVG for the "SimpleAgentix" logo for professional look. I've also identified the necessary components and APIs, and the file structure for the front-end. I'm starting the interactive demo, with tabs to showcase the Gemini integration.


**Beginning Interactive Components**

I've started building the "Interactive Demo" section. I'm focusing on the sub-components: `VoiceTools.tsx` for audio functionality and `ChatBot.tsx` for text-based interactions. The structure is coming together, and I'm eager to connect these components to the Gemini APIs. I'm now implementing the tabbed cards within the demo.
